title: ZEBRAHOOD 2026 (Tokyo) — Eric joins the Zebras and Company gathering on whether a company can hold its mission as it grows
summary: Zebras and Company and Tokyo Zebras Unite have confirmed Eric for the keynote at ZEBRAHOOD 2026, a one-day gathering in Setagaya for owners, workers, researchers, officials and financiers who question what a company is. The organisers say he will use the new book as the starting point for governance that keeps a mission intact.
